contradictions.title: Bundled IV_FAIL with SPRINT_COMPLETE closeout
contradictions.description: The bundle contains iv-results.json with verdict=IV_FAIL (45/46 PASS, 1 FAIL). The bundled sprint-closeout.json claims verdict=SPRINT_COMPLETE and iv.verdict=IV_PASS. These contradict. A sprint cannot be cleanly closed if its authoritative IV file says FAIL.
contradictions.root_cause: The bundle was finalized while IV-07 was still failing (Lane I taskcards pending). The final IV re-run (which passed 46/46) was performed AFTER the bundle was built and the iv-results.json was not re-staged before bundle creation.

contradictions.title: Bundled closeout SHA mismatch
contradictions.description: The bundled sprint-closeout.json claims evidence_bundle.sha256=9a34a24060d87a3368a05a3efc3b22def9bec82afef0528387fdd665d8f526b7 but the actual bundle SHA is 0cfddd35f4a013eff83e2d28266e90fe6c35f7e1a37ff82af7c78fe026fc4de4.
contradictions.root_cause: sprint-closeout.json was updated with the new SHA after the final bundle rebuild, but the bundle was not rebuilt again to capture this update. The bundle contains the previous version of sprint-closeout.json.

contradictions.title: Bundled closeout size mismatch
contradictions.description: The bundled sprint-closeout.json claims size_bytes=747861 but actual bundle size is 747902.
contradictions.root_cause: Same root cause as W14-CONTRA-02: closeout was updated after bundle was frozen.

contradictions.title: IV re-run performed after bundle finalization
contradictions.description: The sprint process re-ran IV to get 46/46 PASS and updated iv-results.json on disk, but this happened AFTER the bundle was already built. The bundle therefore contains the stale IV_FAIL result. The correct protocol is: run IV, verify PASS, build bundle (which captures the IV_PASS result), then write sidecar.
contradictions.root_cause: IV was run, found 45/46 (expected since Lane I pending), then bundle was built, then Lane I taskcards closed, then final IV re-run — but bundle was not rebuilt again.
contradictions.prevention: CVB validators (Lane B) must check: closeout.iv.verdict == bundle_iv_results.verdict

contradictions.title: Adversarial review did not catch IV_FAIL/SPRINT_COMPLETE contradiction
contradictions.description: The final adversarial review (AR-09) claimed the IV script is a real integrity check, but the review only verified the IV script logic and taskcard state — it did not verify that the BUNDLED iv-results.json agreed with the closeout claims.
contradictions.root_cause: Adversarial review protocol checked taskcard states and file existence but not bundle-internal consistency of iv-results.json vs closeout.
contradictions.prevention: Final adversarial review must explicitly open bundle and compare iv-results.json verdict against closeout.iv.verdict.

contradictions.title: Old /net/ catalog URLs promoted to CIV without current canonical browser proof
contradictions.description: 21 MCU entries were upgraded to CIV using prior sprint catalog cross-reference (SOURCE_CATALOG_VERIFIED). The canonical_urls assigned use the old /net/ infix format. No browser/root-link verification was performed. Current canonical URLs may differ.
contradictions.affected_entries: cad (5), finance (1), font (2), gis (2), html (3), omr (2), psd (1), svg (1), tasks (1), tex (1), threed (2)
contradictions.note: Progress is valid — catalog evidence is real. But publication should not proceed until current canonical URL is confirmed or legacy URL policy is documented.

contradictions.title: barcode/read-barcode MCU not fully resolved
contradictions.description: barcode/read-barcode was correctly retained as MCU with page_source_status=SOURCE_CATALOG_VERIFIED_SPLIT_AMBIGUOUS. However the ambiguity between 1d-barcode-reader and 2d-barcode-reader was not resolved — Wave 14 deferred to Wave 15 Playwright verification.
contradictions.wave15_action: Perform root-link/browser verification to determine whether read-barcode maps to 1D, 2D, or both, and apply alias or split policy.
